title: Status gateway
description: Health and counters of the Modbus gateway, published retained on plant/{unit_id}/status/gateway every few seconds. The counters are monotonic since the gateway started; a consumer compares two messages to get a rate.

last_seq.description: Sequence number of the newest sample the gateway published; 0 before the first one.

dropped_total.description: Samples the gateway never read because the ring buffer overwrote them while it was behind.

polls_total.description: Poll cycles completed since the gateway started.

poll_errors_total.description: Poll cycles that ended in a Modbus read error.

poll_interval_ms.description: Milliseconds the gateway waits between two poll cycles when it has caught up.

samples_per_s.description: Samples published per wall-clock second, averaged over the last reporting window.

modbus.description: The Modbus endpoint the gateway reads from. The gateway only ever reads; it holds no write function code at all.

host.description: Host name or address of the simulator.

connected.description: True while the Modbus client holds an open connection.

map_major.description: Major version of the register map the simulator reports in its header block.

map_minor.description: Minor version of the register map the simulator reports in its header block.

last_error.description: Null while the last poll cycle succeeded, otherwise one English sentence describing it.
